tour.name: Kangaroo Island Private 2-Day Tour from Adelaide: Sea Lions, Remarkable Rocks & Wildlife
tour.subtitle: Two days on Australia's wildlife island with a local guide: the ferry from Cape Jervis, a guided walk among the sea lions of Seal Bay, kangaroos and koalas in the wild, the granite sculptures of Remarkable Rocks, the fur seals of Admirals Arch, and local honey, gin and seafood.

tour.overview:
Kangaroo Island, Australia's third-largest island, lies off the coast of South Australia, separated from the mainland for about 10,000 years. Much of it is protected as national parks and conservation areas, and its wildlife is abundant and relaxed: kangaroos, wallabies, koalas, echidnas, sea lions and fur seals. Although bushfires burned much of the west in 2019 and 2020, the forests are regenerating and the wildlife has returned.

This private two-day tour takes you from Adelaide with a local guide, by ferry, with a night on the island and time for the best wildlife sites, the coastal wonders of Flinders Chase and local produce.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: 2 days, 1 night
• Start and end: your hotel in Adelaide
• Type: private tour with local guide and vehicle; ferry; 1 night with breakfast and dinner
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability, your hotel and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: easy

WHAT YOU SEE
• Seal Bay.
• Flinders Chase National Park: Remarkable Rocks and Admirals Arch.
• Wild kangaroos and koalas.
• Little Sahara dunes.
• Local producers.

WHY THIS WORKS
One night on the island allows wildlife viewing at dawn and dusk, when animals are most active, and the long distances on the island are easy with a private guide.

WHO IT SUITS
Wildlife lovers, families and photographers.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
For a shorter trip, ask us about a day tour by plane from Adelaide.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
The drive from Adelaide to Cape Jervis is about 2 hours, and the ferry 45 minutes. Avoid driving at night on the island because of wildlife; your guide plans the day accordingly.

days.name: Ferry to Kangaroo Island, Seal Bay, Little Sahara and local produce
days.description:
What to expect: the crossing and the island’s wildlife and flavours.

Your guide collects you at about 6:45 and drives south through the Fleurieu Peninsula to Cape Jervis for the ferry. On the island, you taste honey from the Ligurian bees, a pure strain introduced in the 1880s and now protected on the island, and local gin.

After lunch, you walk with a ranger on the beach at Seal Bay among a colony of Australian sea lions, one of the rarest sea lions in the world, resting and nursing their pups. You see the white dunes of Little Sahara, and in the late afternoon look for kangaroos and wallabies grazing in the fields. Dinner is at your lodge.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
06:45 – Pick-up in Adelaide.
09:00 – Ferry from Cape Jervis.
10:30 – Honey and gin tasting.
12:30 – Lunch.
14:00 – Seal Bay walk.
15:30 – Little Sahara.
17:00 – Wildlife at dusk.
19:00 – Dinner at the lodge.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Sandboarding at Little Sahara can be added.

INCLUDED: guide, ferry, tastings, lunch, Seal Bay, dinner.
NOT INCLUDED: drinks.

Overnight: lodge on Kangaroo Island.
Meals: lunch, dinner.

days.name: Flinders Chase, Remarkable Rocks, Admirals Arch and koalas
days.description:
What to expect: the wild west of the island.

After breakfast, you drive west to the Flinders Chase National Park. At Remarkable Rocks, huge granite boulders on a dome above the sea have been carved by wind and waves into strange shapes, coloured orange by lichen. At Admirals Arch, a boardwalk leads down to a natural rock arch with stalactites, where New Zealand fur seals rest on the rocks below.

After lunch, you look for koalas in the eucalyptus at Hanson Bay and walk on an empty beach before returning to the ferry and driving back to Adelaide, arriving at about 21:00.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:00 – Breakfast.
09:30 – Remarkable Rocks.
10:30 – Admirals Arch.
12:00 – Lunch.
13:30 – Koalas at Hanson Bay.
16:30 – Ferry to Cape Jervis.
21:00 – Back in Adelaide.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Echidnas are often seen by the roads.

INCLUDED: guide, park entry, lunch, ferry, transfer.
NOT INCLUDED: dinner, tips.

Overnight: none.
Meals: breakfast, lunch.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability, hotels and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: Will we see kangaroos?
faq.answer: Almost certainly, especially at dawn and dusk.

faq.question: Will we see koalas?
faq.answer: Very likely at Hanson Bay. They are wild, so sightings are never guaranteed.

faq.question: Can we fly instead of taking the ferry?
faq.answer: Yes, from Adelaide to Kingscote in about 30 minutes, on request.

faq.question: What kind of lodge is used?
faq.answer: A comfortable lodge or boutique hotel with dinner and breakfast.

faq.question: Is the island recovering from the fires?
faq.answer: Yes. The forests are regenerating and the wildlife has returned in most areas.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes. Child seats are provided free of charge on request.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: Largely. Seal Bay and Remarkable Rocks have boardwalks; Admirals Arch has stairs.

faq.question: Can we add a winery?
faq.answer: Yes. The island has several wineries and an oyster farm.

faq.question: What should we wear?
faq.answer: Layers, a windproof jacket, comfortable shoes, a hat and sun cream.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: September to April. Winter is cooler but quiet, with good wildlife viewing.

faq.question: Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tipping is not expected in Australia, where wages are higher, but it is always appreciated for excellent service.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 72 hours before the tour. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
